# 微软 FY26 Q4（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）三大业务分部完整分析报告

> 数据来源：`press_release.txt`（新闻稿）、`financial_statements.txt`「Segment Results」「Income Statements」工作表、`transcript.txt`（电话会记录）、`metrics.txt`（投资者指标）。金额单位：百万美元。

---

## 一、全公司合计（FY26 Q4）

| 指标 | FY26 Q4 | FY25 Q4 | 同比变化 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 总收入 | 90,007 | 76,441 | +18% |
| 总收入成本 | 29,525 | 24,014 | +22.9% |
| 毛利润 | 60,482 | 52,427 | +15.4% |
| 研发费用 | 9,997 | 8,829 | +13.2% |
| 销售与市场 | 7,595 | 7,285 | +4.3% |
| 管理费用 | 2,287 | 1,990 | +14.9% |
| 经营费用合计 | 19,879 | 18,104 | +9.8% |
| 经营利润 | 40,603 | 34,323 | +18.3% |
| 经营利润率 | 45.1% | 44.9% | +0.2pct |

出处：`press_release.txt` 第 20000–20300 字符（收入利润表）；`financial_statements.txt`「Income Statements」工作表。

微软 FY26 Q4 收入 900 亿美元（+18%，恒定汇率 +17%），经营利润 406 亿美元（+18%），净利润 358 亿美元（+31% GAAP / +22% non-GAAP，non-GAAP 剔除 OpenAI 投资影响）。Microsoft Cloud 收入 593 亿美元（+27%），商业剩余履约义务（RPO）同比+84% 至 6,780 亿美元。

---

## 二、分部一：Productivity and Business Processes（生产力和业务流程）

### 2.1 财务数据（FY26 Q4）

|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 37,847 | 33,112 | +14.3%（恒定汇率 +14%） |
| 收入成本 | 6,989 | 6,042 | +15.7% |
| 毛利润 | 30,858 | 27,070 | +14.0% |
| 毛利率 | 81.5% | 81.8% | -0.3pct |
| 经营费用 | 8,958 | 8,077 | +10.9% |
| 经营利润 | 21,900 | 18,993 | +15.3% |
| 经营利润率 | 57.9% | 57.4% | +0.5pct |

出处：`financial_statements.txt`「Segment Results」工作表；同比由笔者据同一工作表 FY25 Q4 数据计算。

### 2.2 增长驱动因素（电话会原文）

- **M365 Commercial 云**：电话会 transcript 第 22960 字符起——"M365 Commercial cloud revenue increased 16% on an adjusted basis when normalized for the prior-year comparable that benefited from 2 points of in-period revenue recognition. And on a reported basis, revenue growth was 14%."（注：FY25 Q4 同期因 Windows Commercial 本地组件一次性确认受益 2 个百分点，剔除后可比增速为 16%）。本季度净付费席位增加数环比翻倍以上，付费席位超 3,000 万（`press_release.txt`）；Premium 产品组合包括 Copilot、E5 及 E7 早期 traction 推动 ARPU 增长。
- **M365 Commercial 本地产品**：收入 +19%，"driven by large, long-duration M365 contracts that resulted in higher in-period revenue recognition from the Windows Commercial on-premises component"（transcript 第 22960 字符）。
- **M365 Consumer 云**：+24%（恒定汇率 +22%），"again driven by ARPU growth"，订阅用户 +7%（transcript 第 22960 字符）。
- **LinkedIn**：+12%（恒定汇率 +10%），"primarily driven by Marketing Solutions"（transcript 第 22960 字符）。
- **Dynamics 365**：+13%（恒定汇率 +12%），"against a strong prior-year comparable. Bookings growth in ERP remains healthy, while CRM continued to moderate with longer sales cycles"（transcript 第 22960 字符）。

### 2.3 利润率说明

"Segment gross margin dollars increased 14% and 13% in constant currency. And gross margin percentage decreased slightly with increased M365 Copilot usage… Operating expenses increased 11% primarily driven by the shared R&D investments mentioned earlier. Operating income increased 15% and 14% in constant currency. And operating margins increased year-over-year to 58%."（transcript 第 22960 字符）

|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 39,306 | 29,878 | +31.6%（恒定汇率 +31%） |
| 收入成本 | 16,876 | 11,845 | +42.5% |
| 毛利润 | 22,430 | 18,033 | +24.4% |
| 毛利率 | 57.1% | 60.3% | -3.2pct |
| 经营费用 | 6,475 | 5,893 | +9.9% |
| 经营利润 | 15,955 | 12,140 | +31.4% |
| 经营利润率 | 40.6% | 40.6% | 基本持平 |

出处：`financial_statements.txt`「Segment Results」工作表；同比由笔者计算。

### 3.2 增长驱动因素（电话会原文）

- **Azure 及其他云服务**：收入 +43%（恒定汇率 +43%）。"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."（transcript 第 24808 字符起）
- **GitHub Copilot**："Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."（transcript 第 24808 字符）
- **本地服务器**："revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."（transcript 第 24808 字符）

### 3.3 利润率说明

"Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure. Segment gross margins were also impacted by growing GitHub Copilot usage, though margins improved through the quarter with the June business model change to usage-based pricing. Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier. Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."（transcript 第 24808 字符）

|---|---|---|---|
| 收入 | 12,854 | 13,451 | -4.4%（恒定汇率 -5%） |
| 收入成本 | 5,660 | 6,127 | -7.6% |
| 毛利润 | 7,194 | 7,324 | -1.8% |

出处：`financial_statements.txt`「Segment Results」工作表；同比由笔者计算。

### 4.2 下滑驱动因素（电话会原文）

- **Windows OEM 与设备**：-7%（恒定汇率 -7%），"Windows OEM decreased 5% driven by lower PC market demand and a high prior-year comparable that benefited from Windows 10 end of support."（transcript 第 26435 字符）
- **搜索广告（不含 TAC）**：+10%（恒定汇率 +9%），"driven by higher revenue per search across Edge and Bing, as well as higher volume, though growth was impacted by third-party partnerships."（transcript 第 26435 字符）
- **Xbox 内容与服务**：-10%（恒定汇率 -11%），"against a prior-year comparable that benefited from strong first-party content performance."（transcript 第 26435 字符）

### 4.3 利润率说明

"Segment gross margin dollars decreased 2% and gross margin percentage increased year-over-year driven by lower amortization from the Activision acquisition. Operating expenses increased 8% and 7% in constant currency driven by the continued investments in shared R&D noted earlier as well as impairment charges in XBOX. Operating income decreased 14% and 15% in constant currency and operating margins decreased year-over-year to 21%."（transcript 第 27400 字符）

> 注：Xbox 本季度含一次性减值费用（press_release.txt 提及 "severance expense and impairment charges in XBOX"），是经营利润下滑的重要拖累项。

## 六、口径提示（读者注意事项）

1. **分部口径与合并口径的差异**：上表"全公司合计"行来自合并利润表（Income Statements），与各分部简单加总完全一致。但合并利润表按"产品/服务"（Product/Service and other）重新分类，与分部报告口径不同，**不可直接交叉对比**。

2. **经营费用（Operating Expenses）口径**：微软分部报告的"Operating expenses"仅指可直接归属分部的费用；合并利润表中的研发（R&D）、销售与市场（S&M）、管理费用（G&A）合计 19,879 百万美元**恰好等于**三个分部经营费用之和——说明本季度微软将所有 R&D/S&M/G&A 均按分部归集，**不存在未分配的"公司层级"费用**，分部利润加总直接等于合并经营利润。

3. **Microsoft Cloud 收入（593 亿美元）跨分部**：Microsoft Cloud 是一个跨分部披露指标，其中 Azure 属于 Intelligent Cloud、M365 Commercial/Consumer 属于 Productivity and Business Processes、LinkedIn 商业部分亦计入 Commercial。它**不是**一个独立分部，**不能**与三大分部并列相加，否则会重复计算。

4. **恒定汇率 vs 报告口径**：分部收入增速有报告口径与恒定汇率口径两个版本（见 `press_release.txt` "Segment Revenue Constant Currency Reconciliation" 表）。本报告统一采用报告口径（GAAP），与分部利润表原始金额一致。

5. **OpenAI 投资影响**：本季度 GAAP 与 non-GAAP 在合并层面差异主要来自 OpenAI 投资净收益 4.8 亿美元（影响净利润，不影响分部收入与经营利润）。分部经营利润不受此影响。

6. **Xbox 一次性减值**：More Personal Computing 分部经营利润下滑包含 Xbox 一次性减值费用（press_release.txt 提及 "impairment charges in XBOX"），若剔除该非经常性项目，该分部利润下滑幅度将显著收窄。**不可将本季度 -13.9% 的利润下滑直接外推为趋势性恶化。**

7. **同比基数效应**：M365 Commercial 云报告口径 +14% 低于恒定汇率调整后 +16%，原因是 FY25 Q4 同期存在 2 个百分点的一次性收入确认利好（transcript 第 22960 字符）；Xbox -10% 也部分源于 FY25 Q4 同期第一方游戏内容强势带来的高基数（transcript 第 26435 字符）。解读同比时需结合基数效应。

8. **数据中心使用寿命变更**：自 FY27 起，微软将数据中心和办公楼的使用寿命从 15 年延长至 25 年（transcript 第 27400 字符起），该变更主要影响折旧的时间分布，对 FY27 经营利润影响"minimal"，但会改变 CapEx 与经营租赁的分类口径——未来 CapEx 口径数据将因此出现结构性下降，**不宜直接与 FY26 及以前年度 CapEx 比较**。

---
